claims.assertion: Mari reports increased Orion Gray activity near Earth and claims some ships used Zeta Gray identification codes.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She speculates this could enable abductions under Zeta permissions.

claims.assertion: Mari says about 500 Taygetan cadets and veterans planned to reinforce Earth orbit, but their Toleka-class ship failed tests and delayed arrival.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

claims.assertion: Mari says Earth-based money is needed to support her and a roughly 30-person crew, including food and equipment unavailable aboard ship.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

coverage_gaps: Other claims about alleged Federation conduct and communication omitted
